Order:
The petitioner submitted an online Application (No.HY2077376489725, dated 05.02.2025) seeking issuance of a new Passport, however, the respondent - Passport Authority has refused to issue the passport on the ground that the petitioner is facing criminal proceedings in C.C.No.5927 of 2018 on the file of learned VI Additional Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Ranga Reddy at L.B.Nagar, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 504 and 506 of IPC.
opennyai_summary.arguments: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that mere arraignment of the petitioner in a criminal case cannot be a ground for denial of passport.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Ranga Reddy at L.B.Nagar, is pending against the petitioner and therefore, refusal to issue passport as per Rules cannot be said to be illegal.
There shall be no order as to costs.
2 Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition, shall stand closed.
